subject: subprocess-lifecycle
a: one ceiling timer started at spawn is the startup bound, the stall detector and the executioner; sized for a ten-minute turn it notices a pre-contact hang or a mid-turn stall only at the ceiling, sized tighter it kills a slow cold start mid-work
b: a time-to-first-byte deadline plus an activity clock armed by the first byte and reset per byte, under a generous ceiling that stays the sole executioner for stalls
read_from: scratch harness liveness-ab.mjs, three child shapes (hang-before-first-byte, slow-cold-start-then-work, work-then-hang), durations scaled /200: A-tight (3000ms) false-kills the working child at 3079ms and detects both hangs at ~3011ms; A-generous (6000ms) spares it and detects both hangs at ~6020ms; B (6000/2500/1000) spares it and detects the hangs at 2511ms and 1862ms
instrument: harness verdict per run; predicate = working child killed, elapsed ms to hang detection
return_condition: when runClaude gains the two clocks, split the `timeout` CliError kind into never-connected and went-silent so lib/text/router.ts can descend differently; thresholds come from a class profile this tree does not carry yet
note: harness imitates the child; it proves the policy discriminates, not the right numbers for this app

subject: conformance-checking
a: waiver entries keyed by file:line:column - an unrelated edit above the site un-matches the entry, the accepted finding resurfaces and the symmetric-mismatch ratchet fails the innocent commit
b: entries keyed by rule id (what the tree does); identity survives every edit that moves code, which is what makes the either-direction mismatch rule affordable
read_from: three tree cases walked: import reorder above an accepted finding (A breaks, B unchanged), rule demotion paired by name across two files (A rots in both, B one search), deleted file carrying findings (A and B identical - the forced-look clause catches it)
instrument: reasoning over the tree's two registers; no position-keyed register exists here to measure
return_condition: a tool with a position-keyed waiver file by default (mutation or type-suppression baselines) enters the tree - key by mutation/symbol name before the first waiver is written
note: already adopted; nothing to ship. The register counts per rule and records no site or motivation, so it is a ratchet with honest keys, not a deviation register
